metadata.student_name: Nguyễn Tấn Hoàng; Trần Thị Hoa Mai; Trần Hoàng Quân; Nguyễn Minh Đức

product_context.problem_statement: Our recruiters handle 300-plus applications for a single entry-level posting and usually judge them in arrival order, so strong candidates buried late in the queue get overlooked and two recruiters can reach opposite calls on the same CV because nothing forces them to weigh the same criteria.
product_context.value_hypothesis: If we surface the evidence that matches the posted requirements in one place, we expect the median time from a complete application to a first human review to drop by roughly half, without shrinking the pool of candidates a recruiter actually looks at.
in_scope: flag missing or inconsistent application data
product_context.user_journey_moment: After application completeness check and before the recruiter builds the shortlist
product_context.fallback_experience: Whenever the assistant is down, returns an error, or gets paused mid-incident, recruiters simply open the plain chronological queue and screen manually with keyword filters, the same process we use today; nothing about hiring depends on the tool being available.

system_profile.purpose: Rank and surface evidence for entry-level job applications so recruiters review the strongest matches first and document every shortlist decision.
system_profile.decision_impact: Recommendations influence which candidates receive recruiter attention and can shape access to interviews, but the assistant never makes the final hiring or rejection decision.
system_profile.deployment_context: A private employer hosts a vendor-supplied screening workflow used remotely by recruiters across multiple offices.

system_boundary.model: LLM-based evidence extractor and deterministic eligibility ranker
system_boundary.application: candidate application portal and recruiter review dashboard

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: A wrong screening call costs a person their shot at a job and the company a possibly strong hire, and the stakes feel higher because the mistake is easy to make quietly. We hold sensitive personal data, the pool is large enough that even small bias compounds, and because errors are hard for applicants to spot, we need humans to review and someone accountable when things go wrong.

vietnam.rationale: We cannot yet say with confidence how our exact screening workflow maps to the AI Law, its implementing decree, and the high-risk AI list. Until a lawyer signs a classification memo that traces our pipeline to the actual texts, we treat the status as unresolved and keep it a release blocker.

eu.rationale: Employment screening sits squarely in the AI Act's Annex III high-risk category, but which obligations bite us, and when, depends on whether we count as provider or deployer and on the current staged timeline. That needs a fresh legal read before we offer the tool in the EU.

legal_classification.other_markets: Any future US rollout would need separate counsel review under Title VII adverse-impact doctrine, which we have not begun.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Median time from a complete application to a first qualified recruiter review drops to two business days or fewer, measured weekly per posting.
product_metrics.risk_kri: The gap in qualified-candidate recall between monitored demographic groups stays at or below five percentage points, computed monthly.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: The count of automatic rejections stays at exactly zero in every reporting period; no candidate is ever removed without a named human reviewer.
product_metrics.review_cadence: We review fairness and incidents monthly, and additionally before any change to job criteria, training data, vendor, model, or target market.

release_blockers: GAP-01: Vietnam classification memo not yet signed
GAP-02: EU AI Act compliance evidence not yet independently verified
GAP-03: independent fairness audit not yet completed
release_decision.next_review_trigger: We re-review on any threshold breach, incident, vendor or model change, new target market, or on 2026-10-31, whichever comes first.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Even with these controls we accept that a recommendation can still steer attention away from a qualified candidate. We keep the tool advisory only, disable automatic rejection, give applicants an appeal path, and halt deployment if the disparity or override thresholds are crossed.
